doc.title: Louis Armstrong and Herman Chittison Interview, 1960-05-04

title: Playing the Sloppy Henry record to jog memory
summary: The interviewer plays the Sloppy Henry record to see if Montgomery recognizes the voice or Eddie Haywood. The tape trails off.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well, now, Eddie, I live down in the alley. I live down in the alley. Well, I can't hear as I can be. Honey, I can be. Oh, my baby, I live down in the alley. That doesn't sound familiar to you. Well, now, Eddie, Eddie Haywood is on this label saying that he recorded with Sloppy Henry.
Yeah. Henry and Burr, Sloppy and Burr. See if this sounds like Haywood to you. Hey, we're singing, Jim. This is singing. Howdy. Howdy.
